instruction: Candid outdoor full shot of a sunlit park path with tall green trees. The curly-haired young man in a light blue shirt (R1) stands in the center, carrying his partner while smiling and looking to the side. The young woman with a large afro in a sleeveless cream dress (R2) rides on his back, wrapping her arms around his chest with a joyful smile. The young man supports her legs as they share a playful moment. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the leaves, casting a warm glow and soft shadows over the scene.
